description: Rules for AI-created folders and JSON documents under db/.

ai_may_create.notes: Under Hayden/ the AI may create any depth of personal folders/files. New user projects MUST use create_project (Projects/<Name>/ with Read/History/Notes/Plan/Profile) — never a bare create_folder. Under Work/Projects/<Project>/ and inside a focused Projects/<Name>/ the AI may add subfolders and text files. Deep Research briefs live in db/runtime/research/ (host-only; inspect_research only). Chat logs live in db/Chats/ (host-only).

hayden_map.Identity: Core self, sides, personality, voice, boundaries
hayden_map.Desires: Wants, goals, and longings that are not yet a plan
hayden_map.Projects: Informal personal-project notes — not a named Projects/<Name> COP
hayden_map.History: Everyday past events that are not Memories
hayden_map.Secrets: Private vault — passwords, PII, anything marked sensitive
hayden_map.Memories: Autobiography by category, including Milestones for the most important turning points
hayden_map.Inbox: Unsorted lasting scraps in Captures.json — file later via dormant

file_roles.Profile.json: Cold human-readable identity of this COP. Rarely loaded in live talk; dormant compaction updates when identity drifts.
file_roles.Read.json: SHORT hot index only. Load first for this COP. Holds summary/state, small priority lists, path pointers, and needs_update+read_changelog. Never dump the folder here — detail lives in sibling leaves; OAC deep-dives via tools. Main target for SOI Read-refresh compaction.
file_roles.Plan.json: Forward intent and next actions only. Not a fact store.
file_roles.History.json: Append-only rolling event log. Compaction reads this, then folds into Read (and sometimes Profile).
file_roles.Person.json: Dossier for one person under Hayden/Relationships/People/.
file_roles.History/: Archived/rolled-off files; keep active JSON lean.
